name: com.proprecipe.kit
description: Experimental. For prototyping and concept mock-ups, not final production art. Editor-only low-poly prop generator. Build props from a small recipe DSL (rounded boxes, extruded plates, lathes, tori), bake them into one mesh at chosen LOD presets with hidden-face culling and per-material or palette submeshes, read/write the spec JSON shared with the Blender side, and measure/capture the result.
